achievements.name: Castle Escape
achievements.detail: Get out of Peach's Castle after the origami attack and land in Whispering Woods.

achievements.name: Earth Vellumental
achievements.detail: Clear the Earth Vellumental while following the red streamer.

achievements.name: Water Vellumental
achievements.detail: Clear the Water Vellumental on the blue streamer's path.

achievements.name: Fire Vellumental
achievements.detail: Clear the Fire Vellumental along the yellow streamer.

achievements.name: Ice Vellumental
achievements.detail: Clear the Ice Vellumental on the purple streamer's path.

achievements.name: Green Streamer
achievements.detail: Defeat Scissors and clear the green streamer in Bowser's Castle.

achievements.name: Holes Filled
achievements.detail: Fill every Not-Bottomless Hole by spending confetti.

achievements.name: Museum Complete
achievements.detail: Find all 120 Collectible Treasures so they appear in the Musée Champignon.

achievements.name: Paper Macho
achievements.detail: Win a fight against a giant Paper Macho enemy.

achievements.name: Luigi Found
achievements.detail: Find Luigi somewhere in the kingdom after he goes missing.
